_comment: Per-water termini overrides for scripts/nhd_trace_catalog.mjs. up: dam:<NHD waterbody gnis_name> | headwater; down: mouth | confluence:<gnis_name> | point:<lat,lng>. expectUp/expectDown are lat,lng + radius (B13 validator). Coordinates/verdicts for clinch-river are the frozen GEOCONV-0 regression baseline (docs/NHD-CONVENTIONS.md §7).

hiwassee-river._note: Appalachia Dam impoundment (Hiwassee Lake) sits in NC outside the graph; the in-unit upstream terminus is the NC state line (YAML: 'from the Appalachia Dam release water at the NC line').
